description:
Send a new 6-digit code to the email of an existing account.

        Use it when the code expired, was lost or was entered wrong 5 times. Limits: 1 per minute, 5 per day.
        The old code stops working. With an expired signup_token, use the new code on POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/signup-token to get a new token.

email.description: Email address used at signup. A new 6-digit code and link are sent there. Example: pat@example.com
email.title: Email

name: resend_code
title: Send a new email code
